hero.headline: Pots for slow mornings and long dinners.
hero.sub: I throw, glaze and fire every piece by hand in a converted garage. New work drops once a month and usually sells out within a day.

sections.title: Made slowly, on purpose
sections.text:
I started on a secondhand wheel during a long winter and never stopped. Everything is food-safe, dishwasher-safe and meant to be used every day, not kept on a shelf.
Glazes are mixed in small buckets, so no two firings come out the same. If you love a colour, grab it; it may not come back.

sections.title: Friday, 6 pm Eastern. Forty pieces.
sections.text: People on the list get the shop link an hour early. One email a month, nothing else.

items.a: Yes, across the US and Canada. Every piece is double-boxed, and breakages are replaced free.

items.q: Can I order a custom set?
items.a: Twice a year I open a few custom slots. Join the list to hear first.
